situations.name: US–Iran war and Gulf energy shock
situations.summary: US struck Qeshm and Iran fired on Kuwait and Bahrain on 18 Nov; a tanker was hit off Khasab on 18 Nov; Qatar still mediating.

situations.name: Russia–Ukraine war and NATO's flank
situations.summary: Russia launched a mass missile and drone attack on 20 Nov after Ukraine's strike on the Crimean Bridge; Estonia shuts its Russian border on 1 Dec.

situations.name: Super El Niño
situations.summary: ONI +2.46 for Aug–Oct; global temperature +1.98°C on 13 Nov, a record for the date; Crop Monitor rates Sudan's harvest a failure.

situations.name: Ebola outbreak, DR Congo
situations.summary: ECDC counts 11,504 confirmed Ebola cases and 5,630 deaths in DR Congo to 16 Nov; Africa CDC says it is not under control.

situations.name: Sudan war
situations.summary: IPC warns famine risk is rising in Darfur and Kordofan; a rights group said on 16 Nov an army air attack killed 13 in western Sudan.

situations.name: France: debt stress and protests
situations.summary: France–Bund 10-year spread eased to about 145–150bp on 19 Nov after closing above 150bp in most sessions since late Oct; 146,000 joined a 17 Nov strike.

situations.name: Energy shock feeding inflation
